measures.what: outer diameter of the board, and board thickness
measures.reply: led disk diameter: I can't measure that; led disk thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: the two mounting holes near the centre: hole diameter, centre-to-centre spacing, and the distance from the board centre to each hole; also is the line through the holes along or across the direction the input wires leave?
measures.reply: led disk hole diameter: 3.3 mm (each of the two small holes near the centre); led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12; led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: on the back (no-LED side): tallest thing sticking out (connector, parts) and how high, and where the connector is (distance from centre)
measures.reply: led disk hole positions: on a line through the centre, one at 3 o'clock and one at 9 o'clock, with the input wires at 12

measures.what: length, width and thickness; corner hole diameter and hole centre-to-centre spacing along length and width
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: height of the tallest thing above the board's top face (ESP32 on its headers, capacitor, terminals), and anything sticking out below the board (solder joints, pins)
measures.reply: perfboard size: 50 x 70 mm; perfboard corner holes: 2.4 mm across, and 0.9 mm from the edge of each hole to the board's edge; perfboard grid: 18 x 24 holes at 2.54 mm; perfboard thickness: I can't measure that

measures.what: which perfboard edge it faces (short or long), how far the port mouth is from that board edge (+ if it overhangs), its centre height above the perfboard top face, and its sideways offset from the board's centre line
measures.reply: esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 height: it stands about 16 mm above the perfboard in its female headers; 11.05 mm of that is to the underside of its board; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge; esp32 usb port height: the bottom of its USB-C receptacle is 12.54 mm above the perfboard's top, and the receptacle is about 3.2 mm tall and 10.67 mm wide, its centre 3.99 mm off the ESP32's centreline

measures.what: width and thickness of the plastic grip (overmold) behind the metal tip, and length of the metal tip
measures.reply: I can't measure that. Use your best judgment.

measures.item: wall screws the light will hang on
measures.what: head diameter, shank diameter, and the horizontal distance between the two screws (or are they not in yet?)
measures.reply: wall screws size: #8 round-head screws in 1/4 inch anchors; I bought ones with heads 9 mm across at most; wall screws spacing: I can put them wherever you say

measures.what: rough outer diameter with a ruler or tape measure across the middle (to the nearest few mm is fine), and is the back flat apart from the 4-pin connector? How tall does the connector stand off the back, and how far from the centre is it?
measures.reply: led disk between holes: 30.2 mm (from the nearest edge of each hole, with calipers pulled in at the edges); led disk diameter: I can't measure that

measures.what: Is the USB-C port at a short (50 mm) end of the perfboard? Does the port stick out past the perfboard's edge or sit inside it, and by how much? Which way is it offset 3.99 mm from the ESP32 centreline (towards which long edge, looking down at the ESP32 with the port facing you, left or right)? Is the ESP32 centred across the perfboard's width?
measures.reply: esp32 size: 63.17 long and 28.25 wide mm; esp32 usb port: 4.80 mm from the outside of its USB-C port to the nearest edge of the ESP32 board, and 7.53 mm from the ESP32's edge to the perfboard's edge
